title: Punjab Commission on Irregular Housing Schemes Second Amendment Ordinance 2021

sections.shortTitle: Punjab Commission on Irregular Housing Schemes Second Amendment Ordinance 2021
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

PLD 2021 Punjab Statutes 757
PLD 2021 Punjab Statutes 757
ORDINANCE XXVI OF 2021
PUNJAB COMMISSION ON IRREGULAR HOUSING SCHEMES
(SECOND AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2021
An Ordinance to amend the Punjab Commission on
Irregular Housing Schemes Act, 2021
[Gazette of Punjab Extraordinary,
9th November, 2021]
No.
Legis:13-24/2021, dated 9.11.2021.---The
following Ordinance promulgated by Governor of the Punjab is hereby published
for general information:
It
is necessary to amend the Punjab Commission on Irregular Housing Schemes Act,
2021 (XXXIII of 2021) for better functioning of the Commission and for the
ancillary matters.
Provincial
Assembly of the Punjab is not in session and Governor of the Punjab is
satisfied that circumstances exist which render it necessary to take immediate
action.
In
exercise of the powers conferred under clause (1) of Article 128 of the
Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, Governor of the Punjab is
pleased to make and promulgate the following Ordinance:
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This
Ordinance may be cited as the Punjab Commission on Irregular Housing Schemes
(Second Amendment) Ordinance, 2021.
(2) This
Ordinance shall come into force at once.

Insertion of section 5-A in Act XXXIII of 2021

PLD 2021 Punjab Statutes 757
PLD 2021 Punjab Statutes 757

It
is necessary to amend the Punjab Commission on Irregular Housing Schemes Act,
2021 (XXXIII of 2021) for better functioning of the Commission and for the
ancillary matters.
Provincial
Assembly of the Punjab is not in session and Governor of the Punjab is
satisfied that circumstances exist which render it necessary to take immediate
action.
In
exercise of the powers conferred under clause (1) of Article 128 of the
Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, Governor of the Punjab is
pleased to make and promulgate the following Ordinance:
7. Insertion
of section 5-A in Act XXXIII of 2021.---In the Act, after section 5, the following section 5-A shall be
inserted:
"5-A.
The Council.---(1) The Government shall, by notification in the official
Gazette, establish a Council for carrying out the purposes of this Act.
(2) The
Council shall consist of the following members nominated by the Government:
(a)
a retired Judge of the
Supreme Court
Chairperson
(b)
two retired Federal or
Provincial Government servants in BS 22 or equivalent; and
Member
(c)
a representative of
Local Government and Community Development Department in BS 20 or above
Member/ Secretary
(3) The
Council shall be headed by the Chairperson, and require a minimum two members
to function.
(4) The
members of the Council shall receive such honorarium as may be determined by
the Chief Minister.
(5) The
Council shall review the recommendations of the Commission and give approval
thereon and issue directions to the concerned Government agencies.
(6) The
approvals and directions of the Council shall be binding on the concerned
Government agencies.
(7) Where
in the opinion of the Government, the Chairperson or a member of the Council is
not performing in the best public interest or not functioning effectively or
efficiently, the Government may remove him.
(8) The
Government shall provide secretarial and logistic support to the Council.
(9) The
Government shall provide requisite funds for proper functioning of the Council.
(10) The
Council shall stand dissolved upon expiry of one year of promulgation of the
Punjab Commission for Regularization of Irregular Housing Schemes Ordinance
2021 (XVII of 2021) unless the Government, by notification in the official
Gazette, extends its term for a further period of one year.".
